simp_chinese.origin_heart_of_devouring_desc: 我们的文明从未把星球视作疆界。它们只是尚未剥离的食物。女王·白绮以冰冷的意志统御族群：异族、生命与整个世界，最终都将归入唯一的王座。
simp_chinese.origin_heart_of_devouring_effects: §Y仅限灭绝国策§!。绑定初始母星，获得 §G+2§! 区划容量和 §G+10%§! 岗位产出。吞噬自有自然殖民地，将合格本族人口迁回母星；累计每 §Y4§! 格原生物质增加 §G1§! 母星区划。通用拆解每累计 §Y6§! 格制造 §G100§! 本族人口；噬岩者保留原版随机收益。通常 15～25 格星球耗时 3～5 年。母星区划使用正常岗位，资源区划可突破地貌上限；灵能与天灾遵守原版条件。
simp_chinese.eep_requires_exterminator: 需要吞噬蜂群、铁心灭绝者、种族洁癖或焦土灭绝国策。
simp_chinese.decision_eep_devour_desc: 白绮不承认异族对星球的任何权利。留下足够的本族消化者，把人口、地壳与熔融核心逐一收归母星。
simp_chinese.eep_devour_effect: 消化耗时为剩余原生物质 Q × 2.4 月，向上取整。结算时回迁合格本族人口，源星永久破碎。容量按累计 Q 每 4 格兑换；通用拆解人口按累计 Q 每 6 格制造 100，余料跨星保留。噬岩者使用原版随机消费收益。母星失联或战斗期间暂停；末期等待原版肃清结束。
simp_chinese.eep_source_required: 需要自有、和平、非母星的自然殖民地；母星必须仍由本国控制。不能吞噬巨构、方舟、环段、突触凝练器或纳米世界。
simp_chinese.eep_seed_required: 源星需有至少 100 非肃清本族人口，或母星有超过 100 的本族人口供补足差额；不得迁走母星最后一批人口。消化者不免费生成。
simp_chinese.eep_material_required: 需要尚未损毁的原生物质。
simp_chinese.decision_eep_audience_desc: 走入吞噬之心的王庭。白绮审视的是归还王座的物质和下一颗即将毁灭的星球。
simp_chinese.eep_audience_effect: 查看绑定母星、累计物质、人口制造、活动任务和真实飞升状态。报告只读，不发放奖励。
simp_chinese.eep_capacity_desc: 吞噬所得物质成为真实可建区划容量；星球原始尺寸不变。
simp_chinese.d_eep_core_desc: 女王的意志汇聚于此。只有原始族群持有王座时，正常岗位获得 10% 加算产出；地壳容量属于这颗星球。
simp_chinese.situation_eep_devouring_desc: 没有生命值得保留，没有地壳值得浪费。[Target.GetName] 将被消化，最终成为唯一母星的一部分。
simp_chinese.situation_eep_devouring_monthly_change_t: 每个有效推进月增加 1 进度。母星失联、源星占领或地面战暂停。完成后若肃清仍在进行，则等待最后一批异族消失。
simp_chinese.eep_digesting_desc: 把这颗星球的一切用途归结为供养王座。
simp_chinese.eep_devour_approach_desc: 继续消化直到世界破碎。
simp_chinese.eep_cancel_approach_desc: 终止任务，不发放任何完成收益。已经产生的损毁、原版收益和真实人口迁移不会回滚。
simp_chinese.eep_block_core: 王座失联：绑定母星不在本国控制下。吞噬与结算暂停，收复同一母星后恢复。
simp_chinese.eep_block_combat: 消化站处于占领或地面战，推进暂停。
simp_chinese.eep_block_purge: 物质消化已完成；等待原版肃清结束，不提前毁灭人口或重复消费。
simp_chinese.eep.10.name: 唯一的王座
simp_chinese.eep.10.desc:
白绮立于母星的黑曜石王庭，垂眼望着星图。

‘疆界？’她的声音毫无温度。‘我不需要为食物划定疆界。’

没有对异族的许诺，没有怜悯，更没有退路。族群的一切必须供养这颗心脏。被征服的世界将交出自己的生命、地壳与核心，而女王不会为其中任何一样感到惋惜。
simp_chinese.eep.11.name: 一颗世界的余烬
simp_chinese.eep.11.desc:
最后一层地壳从消化站剥离。曾经的海洋和城市不再拥有名字，只有归还母星的物质数量。

白绮扫过报告，神情甚至没有一丝愉悦。‘下一个。’

已吞噬世界：[Root.eep_worlds]；累计原生物质：[Root.eep_c]；母星新增容量：[Root.eep_d]；通用拆解制造人口：[Root.eep_made]。这些数字记录既成结算，本次消息不追加奖励。

王庭：[Root.GetEEPCourtStage]。最近一颗世界：新增容量 [Root.eep_last_capacity]；回迁本族 [Root.eep_last_return]；通用制造 [Root.eep_last_manufactured]。
simp_chinese.eep.13.name: [Root.GetEEPCourtStage]
simp_chinese.eep.13.desc:
母星的地平线再一次延伸。新区划承接真正的住房和岗位，工厂、巢室与神经中枢继续运转。

白绮以指尖掠过星图，把一片异族疆域从未来中抹去。‘他们所谓的故土，只是我们的下一层地基。’

累计物质：[Root.eep_c]；新增容量：[Root.eep_d]；已制造人口：[Root.eep_made]。女王记录新的成长阶段，不赠予第二份经济收益。
simp_chinese.eep.30.name: 不可抗拒的意志
simp_chinese.eep.30.desc:
我们的合法灵能飞升已完成。王庭的意识贯穿母星；灵能协调与普通岗位共同支撑这颗不断膨胀的心脏。

白绮俯视虚境中的异族回声，像审视一份毫无价值的残渣。‘不必理解他们。只需让他们服从终局。’

这一刻记录已经取得的原版飞升能力。女王没有赐予额外人口、区划或飞升资格。
simp_chinese.eep.31.name: 以群星铸成刀锋
simp_chinese.eep.31.desc:
我们的天灾进程已实际解锁矿物舰。吞噬所得矿物进入舰队，合金继续供养母星建设；两条生产链在战争中闭合。

白绮望着舰队从王庭上空驶过。‘损失可以补充。迟疑不被允许。’

矿物舰的可用性、成本和后续阶段均沿用原版。女王不会越过 DLC、飞升或特殊项目的条件。
simp_chinese.eep.31.a: 让刀锋指向下一颗星球。
simp_chinese.eep.40.name: 王座失联
simp_chinese.eep.40.desc:
绑定母星的控制权已经中断。吞噬局势停在原处，所有尚未结算的收益被封存。

白绮的指令冰冷而直接：‘夺回来。代价不在考虑之内。’

收复同一颗母星后任务恢复。迁都不能制造第二颗吞噬之心。
simp_chinese.eep.41.name: 王座复归
simp_chinese.eep.41.desc:
原始母星重新回到族群控制之下。尚存的消化站恢复推进，等待结算的任务仍按各自凭证兑现一次。

白绮没有庆贺。‘继续。让他们为这段耽搁付出一切。’
simp_chinese.eep.42.name: 心脏的终止
simp_chinese.eep.42.desc:
原始母星已经不再是可用殖民地。吞噬之心没有备用王座。

未完成任务将终止；不会重绑首都、复制容量或补发人口。幸存殖民地继续沿用原版规则经营。白绮留下的最后指令，依旧没有给怜悯留下位置。
simp_chinese.eep.100.name: 女王·白绮：王庭账簿
simp_chinese.eep.100.desc:
‘我只看已经归还王座的东西。’

simp_chinese.eep.101.name: 消化站：[eep_report_source.GetName]
simp_chinese.eep.101.desc:
‘毁灭不是借口。把进度交代清楚。’

simp_chinese.eep_path_generic: 通用拆解：累计物质制造人口
simp_chinese.eep.32.name: 王庭的下一柄刀锋
simp_chinese.eep.32.desc:
白绮审视新近解锁的舰型。‘他们的反抗，必须比上一颗世界更短。’

实际武灾阶段：[Root.eep_crisis]。阶段 3 解锁 $crisis_destroyer$，阶段 4 解锁 $crisis_cruiser$；船型、装配和维护沿用原版，此消息不授予能力或奖励。

english.origin_heart_of_devouring_desc: Our civilization never regarded worlds as borders. They are food yet to be stripped bare. Queen Vivhite rules with an icy will: alien lives and entire planets will eventually belong to the only throne.
english.origin_heart_of_devouring_effects: §YExtermination civics only§!. Bind the original homeworld, gaining §G+2§! district capacity and §G+10%§! job output. Devour owned natural colonies and return eligible founder population to the core. Every cumulative §Y4§! units of native matter adds §G1§! homeworld district. Generic dismantling creates §G100§! population per cumulative §Y6§! units; Terravores retain native random rewards. Typical size 15–25 worlds take 3–5 years. Districts use normal jobs; resource districts can exceed terrain limits. Psionics and crisis progression retain vanilla requirements.
english.eep_requires_exterminator: Requires Devouring Swarm, Determined Exterminator, Fanatic Purifiers, or an extermination scorched-earth civic.
english.decision_eep_devour: Devour: Offer to the Only Throne
english.decision_eep_devour_desc: Vivhite recognizes no alien claim to a world. Leave enough founder population to digest it, then bring its inhabitants, crust and molten core home.
english.eep_devour_effect: Digestion takes Q × 2.4 effective months, rounded up. Completion returns eligible founder population and permanently shatters the source. Capacity is exchanged per cumulative 4 Q; generic dismantling creates 100 population per cumulative 6 Q, carrying remainders across worlds. Terravores retain native random consumption rewards. Core loss or combat pauses progress; final settlement waits for vanilla purging to end.
english.eep_source_required: Requires an owned, peaceful natural colony other than the bound core, with the core under our control. Megastructures, arks, ring segments, the Synaptic Lathe and nanotech worlds are excluded.
english.eep_seed_required: The source needs at least 100 non-purging founder population, or the core needs more than 100 to supply the shortfall. Never relocate the core’s last population. Digestion workers are not created for free.
english.decision_eep_audience_desc: Enter the court of the Heart of Devouring. Vivhite judges the matter returned to her throne and the next world marked for destruction.
english.eep_audience_effect: Read the bound core, cumulative matter, population manufacturing, active tasks and actual ascension status. This report grants no rewards.
english.eep_capacity: Heart of Devouring: Accumulated World Matter
english.eep_capacity_desc: Devoured matter becomes genuine buildable district capacity without changing the planet's original size.
english.d_eep_core_desc: The Queen's will gathers here. Normal jobs receive 10% additive output only while the original people own the throne. Physical capacity belongs to this planet.
english.situation_eep_devouring_desc: No life deserves preservation. No crust deserves waste. [Target.GetName] will become part of the only homeworld.
english.situation_eep_devouring_monthly_change_t: Gain 1 progress each effective month. Core loss, occupation or ground combat pauses progress. Final settlement waits for all vanilla purging to finish.
english.eep_digesting_desc: Reduce every purpose of this world to feeding the throne.
english.eep_devour_approach_desc: Continue digestion until the world shatters.
english.eep_cancel_approach_desc: End the task without completion rewards. Existing devastation, native rewards and actual population relocation remain.
english.eep_block_core: Throne disconnected: the bound core is outside our control. Progress and settlement pause until this same world is recovered.
english.eep_block_combat: The digestion colony is occupied or fighting a ground battle. Progress is paused.
english.eep_block_purge: Digestion is complete. Waiting for vanilla purging to finish; no premature population destruction or repeated consumption.
english.eep.10.name: The Only Throne
english.eep.10.desc:
Vivhite stands in the obsidian court, gazing down at the star chart.

Borders? Her voice carries no warmth. I do not draw borders around food.

There are no promises to aliens, no mercy and no retreat. Everything must feed this heart. Conquered worlds will surrender their lives, crust and cores. The Queen will regret none of it.
english.eep.10.a: Beyond the throne, all may be devoured.
english.eep.11.name: The Ashes of a World
english.eep.11.desc:
The last crust peels away. Oceans and cities have lost their names; only the quantity returned to the core remains.

Vivhite glances at the report without pleasure. Next.

Worlds consumed: [Root.eep_worlds]; cumulative native matter: [Root.eep_c]; added core capacity: [Root.eep_d]; population manufactured by generic dismantling: [Root.eep_made]. These record completed settlement. This message grants no additional reward.

Court: [Root.GetEEPCourtStage]. Latest world: capacity added [Root.eep_last_capacity]; founder population returned [Root.eep_last_return]; generic manufacture [Root.eep_last_manufactured].
english.eep.11.a: Let the ashes feed the heart.
english.eep.13.name: [Root.GetEEPCourtStage]
english.eep.13.desc:
The core's horizon expands again. New districts support real housing and jobs; factories, hive chambers and neural hubs keep working.

Vivhite brushes an alien territory from the star chart. Their ancestral soil is merely our next foundation.

Cumulative matter: [Root.eep_c]; added capacity: [Root.eep_d]; manufactured population: [Root.eep_made]. The Queen records a new growth stage without a second economic reward.
english.eep.30.name: An Irresistible Will
english.eep.30.desc:
Our lawful psionic ascension is complete. The court's consciousness reaches across the core; psionic coordination and normal jobs sustain its growing heart.

Vivhite regards alien echoes in the Shroud as worthless residue. There is no need to understand them. Only to make them submit to the end.

This moment records vanilla ascension already achieved. It grants no extra population, capacity or ascension eligibility.
english.eep.31.name: Stars Forged into Blades
english.eep.31.desc:
Our crisis progression has unlocked mineral ships. Devoured minerals feed the fleet while alloys sustain core construction; war closes both production loops.

Vivhite watches the fleet pass overhead. Losses can be replaced. Hesitation is forbidden.

Ship availability, costs and later stages follow vanilla rules. The Queen bypasses no DLC, ascension or special project requirement.
english.eep.31.a: Point the blade at the next world.
english.eep.40.name: Throne Disconnected
english.eep.40.desc:
Control of the bound core has been interrupted. Digestion stops and unsettled rewards remain sealed.

Vivhite's order is cold and direct. Recover it. The cost is irrelevant.

Recovering the same core resumes tasks. Moving the capital cannot create a second heart.
english.eep.40.a: Recover the throne at any cost.
english.eep.41.name: The Throne Restored
english.eep.41.desc:
The original homeworld is under our control again. Surviving digestion colonies resume progress; each pending task settles once against its own receipt.

Vivhite does not celebrate. Continue. Make them pay for the delay with everything they have.
english.eep.42.name: The Heart Stops
english.eep.42.desc:
The original homeworld is no longer a usable colony. The Heart of Devouring has no replacement throne.

Unfinished tasks end. There is no capital rebinding, copied capacity or replacement population. Surviving colonies continue under vanilla rules. The Queen's final order still leaves no room for mercy.
english.eep.100.name: Queen Vivhite: Court Ledger
english.eep.100.desc:
I count only what has returned to the throne.

english.eep.32.name: The Court’s Next Blade
english.eep.32.desc:
Vivhite examines the newly unlocked hull. Their resistance must end sooner than that of the last world.

Actual Nemesis stage: [Root.eep_crisis]. Stage 3 unlocks $crisis_destroyer$; stage 4 unlocks $crisis_cruiser$. Hulls, fitting and upkeep remain vanilla. This message grants no ability or reward.
